# ArchiveReader

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Forward-only archive reader. Read each current regular file once; failures update Error.Last().

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#reading-archives-400).

## Close

```PPL
ArchiveReader.Close() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Closes the archive. Safe to repeat; resources are also released when the last handle is dropped.

## Entry

`ArchiveReader.Entry: ArchiveEntry`

Read-only instance property.

Current entry metadata; invalid before Next and at end of iteration. Saved snapshots survive cursor movement and Close.

## Extract

```PPL
ArchiveReader.Extract(STRING destination, [BOOLEAN overwrite]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Extracts the current regular file once to the explicit destination, publishing atomically on success. Overwrite defaults to FALSE; links are never created or followed.

## Format

`ArchiveReader.Format: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

Detected or explicitly selected archive format.

## Next

```PPL
ArchiveReader.Next() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Skips unread current data and advances. FALSE with Error.Last().OK means end; FALSE with an error means failure.

## ReadBytes

```PPL
ArchiveReader.ReadBytes() BYTES
```

Instance function.

Decompresses the current regular file once into BYTES. Empty files and errors both return empty bytes; check Error.Last().

## ReadText

```PPL
ArchiveReader.ReadText() STRING
```

Instance function.

Reads the current regular file once and returns the text before the first NUL or Ctrl-Z, decoded as UTF-8 or CP437 like runtime-400 file text. Use ReadBytes for the complete member.

## Rewind

```PPL
ArchiveReader.Rewind() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Reopens the retained source and resets the cursor, without resetting decoded-byte or entry-visit budgets.

## Valid

`ArchiveReader.Valid: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

True while the reader is open and usable. End of iteration does not close the reader.
